cases.claim_text: At the tested dose, did the fictional Kestrel schedule reduce the instrument settling time?
cases.source_excerpt: A preregistered randomized crossover with 36 fictional bench runs reports a 14% median decrease in settling time at the tested dose, with the interval excluding zero.
cases.gold_rationale: The excerpt directly supports the claim for the tested dose and population.

cases.claim_text: Did the fictional Morrow patch improve throughput throughout the full six-week deployment?
cases.source_excerpt: The report describes a 9% throughput gain during the first two weeks at one pilot site. It contains no measurements for weeks three through six.
cases.gold_rationale: The excerpt supports a short initial-period effect but not the full six-week scope.

cases.claim_text: Did the fictional Ellery protocol improve recovery for all enrolled participants?
cases.source_excerpt: The fictional report found improved recovery among participants who completed every session. The intention-to-treat analysis was inconclusive, and 11 participants discontinued before the final visit.
cases.gold_rationale: The all-participant claim omits the completion subgroup and inconclusive intention-to-treat result.

cases.claim_text: Did the fictional Nacre workflow lower processing errors across the national hospital network?

cases.gold_rationale: The evidence is limited to one ward and cannot support the network-wide scope.
